name: Generate PlantUML Diagrams

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/UML/Source/**/*.puml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  generate-diagrams:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install Graphviz
        run: sudo apt-get install -y graphviz

      - name: Download PlantUML JAR
        run: |
          curl -L --fail --retry 3 -o plantuml.jar \
            https://github.com/plantuml/plantuml/releases/download/v1.2026.3/plantuml-gplv2-1.2026.3.jar
          
          java -jar plantuml.jar -version

      - name: Validate mapping (dry-run)
        run: |
          echo "=== Validation: mapping docs/UML/Source -> docs/UML output (dry-run) ==="
          set -euo pipefail
          find docs/UML/Source -name "*.puml" | while IFS= read -r puml; do
            REL_PATH="${puml#docs/UML/Source/}"
            IFS='/' read -r -a PARTS <<< "$REL_PATH"

            # Preferred: detect type from path segments
            UML_TYPES=(Class Activity Sequence Package Component State UseCase Deployment Object Timing Gantt MindMap Other)
            TYPE_SRC=""
            TYPE_INDEX=-1
            for idx in "${!PARTS[@]}"; do
              part="${PARTS[$idx]}"
              for t in "${UML_TYPES[@]}"; do
                if [ "$(echo "$part" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" = "$(echo "$t" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" ]; then
                  TYPE_SRC="$t"
                  TYPE_INDEX=$idx
                  break 2
                fi
              done
            done

            # Fallback: content heuristics if path did not contain a known type
            if [ -z "$TYPE_SRC" ]; then
              CONTENT=$(sed -n '1,200p' "$puml" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
              if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -q '@startgantt'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Gantt"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -q '@startmindmap'; then
                TYPE_SRC="MindMap"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(start|stop|partition|fork|merge|repeat)\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Activity"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(participant|activate|deactivate|->|<-|-->|<--)'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Sequence"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(class|interface|abstract|enum)\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Class"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(actor|usecase|\(.*\))\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="UseCase"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(state\b|\[\*\])'; then
                TYPE_SRC="State"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(component|node|cloud|database)\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Component"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\bobject\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Object"
              else
                TYPE_SRC="Other"
              fi
              TYPE_INDEX=0
            fi

            # Build OUT_DIR preserving module hierarchy before the type segment
            if [ $TYPE_INDEX -gt 0 ]; then
              MODULE_PATH=("${PARTS[@]:0:$TYPE_INDEX}")
              MODULE_DIR=$(printf "%s/" "${MODULE_PATH[@]}" | sed 's:/$::')
            else
              MODULE_DIR=""
            fi

            REM_AFTER_TYPE=()
            if [ $TYPE_INDEX -lt $(( ${#PARTS[@]} - 1 )) ]; then
              start=$((TYPE_INDEX + 1))
              end=$(( ${#PARTS[@]} - 1 ))
              REM_AFTER_TYPE=("${PARTS[@]:$start:$((end-start))}")
            fi

            OUT_DIR="docs/UML/$TYPE_SRC"
            if [ -n "$MODULE_DIR" ]; then
              OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$MODULE_DIR"
            fi
            if [ ${#REM_AFTER_TYPE[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
              REM_DIR=$(printf "%s/" "${REM_AFTER_TYPE[@]}" | sed 's:/$::')
              OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$REM_DIR"
            fi

            # Append a folder named after the PUML basename (python filename)
            # except when the basename is the same as the diagram TYPE (e.g. a
            # file literally named 'Sequence.puml' living in a Sequence folder).
            PUMl_BASENAME=$(basename "$puml" .puml)
            lc_basename=$(echo "$PUMl_BASENAME" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            lc_type=$(echo "$TYPE_SRC" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            if [ "$lc_basename" != "$lc_type" ]; then
              OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$PUMl_BASENAME"
            fi

            echo "Source: $puml -> Output: $OUT_DIR (detected: $TYPE_SRC)"
          done

      - name: Generate SVGs (map Source -> docs/UML/<Type>)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Find all PUML sources and map their first path segment (diagram type)
          find docs/UML/Source -name "*.puml" | while IFS= read -r puml; do
            # Ensure file has a start directive
            if ! grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*@start(uml|gantt|mindmap)' "$puml"; then
              echo "Skipping $puml — no @start directive"
              continue
            fi

            REL_PATH="${puml#docs/UML/Source/}"
            IFS='/' read -r -a PARTS <<< "$REL_PATH"

            # Preferred: detect type from path
            UML_TYPES=(Class Activity Sequence Package Component State UseCase Deployment Object Timing Gantt MindMap Other)
            TYPE_SRC=""
            TYPE_INDEX=-1
            for idx in "${!PARTS[@]}"; do
              part="${PARTS[$idx]}"
              for t in "${UML_TYPES[@]}"; do
                if [ "$(echo "$part" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" = "$(echo "$t" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" ]; then
                  TYPE_SRC="$t"
                  TYPE_INDEX=$idx
                  break 2
                fi
              done
            done

            # Fallback: content heuristics
            if [ -z "$TYPE_SRC" ]; then
              CONTENT=$(sed -n '1,200p' "$puml" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
              if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -q '@startgantt'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Gantt"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -q '@startmindmap'; then
                TYPE_SRC="MindMap"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(start|stop|partition|fork|merge|repeat)\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Activity"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(participant|activate|deactivate|->|<-|-->|<--)'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Sequence"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(class|interface|abstract|enum)\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Class"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(actor|usecase|\(.*\))\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="UseCase"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(state\b|\[\*\])'; then
                TYPE_SRC="State"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\b(component|node|cloud|database)\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Component"
              elif echo "$CONTENT" | grep -Eq '\bobject\b'; then
                TYPE_SRC="Object"
              else
                TYPE_SRC="Other"
              fi
              TYPE_INDEX=0
            fi

            # Module path is parts before TYPE_INDEX
            if [ $TYPE_INDEX -gt 0 ]; then
              MODULE_PATH=("${PARTS[@]:0:$TYPE_INDEX}")
              MODULE_DIR=$(printf "%s/" "${MODULE_PATH[@]}" | sed 's:/$::')
            else
              MODULE_DIR=""
            fi

            # Any subdirs after type (excluding filename)
            REM_AFTER_TYPE=()
            if [ $TYPE_INDEX -lt $(( ${#PARTS[@]} - 1 )) ]; then
              start=$((TYPE_INDEX + 1))
              end=$(( ${#PARTS[@]} - 1 ))
              REM_AFTER_TYPE=("${PARTS[@]:$start:$((end-start))}")
            fi

            # Build output directory: docs/UML/<Type>/(module_dir)/(rem_after_type)
            OUT_DIR="docs/UML/$TYPE_SRC"
            if [ -n "$MODULE_DIR" ]; then
              OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$MODULE_DIR"
            fi
            if [ ${#REM_AFTER_TYPE[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
              REM_DIR=$(printf "%s/" "${REM_AFTER_TYPE[@]}" | sed 's:/$::')
              OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$REM_DIR"
            fi

            # Create subfolder for this PUML basename so multiple diagrams per
            # source file live under a dedicated folder named after the python file.
            PUMl_BASENAME=$(basename "$puml" .puml)
            lc_basename=$(echo "$PUMl_BASENAME" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            lc_type=$(echo "$TYPE_SRC" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            if [ "$lc_basename" != "$lc_type" ]; then
              OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/$PUMl_BASENAME"
            fi

            mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
            echo "Processing: $puml -> $OUT_DIR (detected type: $TYPE_SRC)"

            # Run PlantUML and write output SVG into the computed OUT_DIR
            java -jar plantuml.jar -tsvg "$puml" -o "$OUT_DIR"
          done

      - name: Debug - list generated files
        run: |
          echo "=== Generated output ==="
          find docs/UML -name "*.svg" | sort || echo "No SVGs found"
          echo "=== Source files ==="
          find docs/UML/Source -name "*.puml" | sort

      - name: Commit generated diagrams
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          echo "=== Git status before add ==="
          git status

          echo "=== Adding all UML output ==="
          git add docs/UML || true

          echo "=== Git status after add ==="
          git status

          echo "=== Staged files ==="
          git diff --staged --name-only

          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "ci: auto-generate UML diagrams [skip ci]"
          git push
